worldDescs.xianxia: Sects, immortal cities, caves, cloud seas, and cultivation rules form an Eastern fantasy world.
worldDescs.urban: Credible Chinese cities, careers, and everyday relationships for modern short drama.
worldDescs.historical: Lock one era first, then unify etiquette, costume, props, and architecture.
worldDescs.suspense: Urban texture, clue systems, and psychological pressure build readable suspense.
worldDescs.science-fiction: Tech rules, social structures, and functional spaces support future stories.
worldDescs.pastoral: Region, season, labor, and nature participate in the narrative.

toneDescs.epic: Scale, order, and fate create epic weight—not constant darkness or VFX piles.
toneDescs.dark: Unknown, taboo, and pressure create darkness while keeping information readable.
toneDescs.light-comedy: Grand situations meet deadpan reactions; bright without childishness.
toneDescs.romantic: Distance, light, and environmental detail express relationships—not sugary filters.
toneDescs.healing: Warmth from concrete care, labor, and repair—not generic soft glow.

mediaDescs.live-action: Real actors, credible optics, costumes, and physical environments.
mediaDescs.3d-anime: High-quality 3D animation with Eastern anime design and cinematic scenes.
mediaDescs.3d-cartoon: Stylized proportions, clear silhouettes, soft materials, readable expressions.
mediaDescs.2d-guoman: Stable line art, cel shading, and Eastern painted backgrounds.
mediaDescs.ink: Xuan paper, ink stages, brush energy, and negative space for Eastern storytelling.

characterDescs.realistic: Real bone structure, age, skin, and body proportions.
characterDescs.semi-real: Eastern bone structure balanced with idealized design; keep believable structure.
characterDescs.anime: Elongated proportions, clear facial design, stable silhouettes.
characterDescs.stylized: Exaggerated proportions and readable expressions for comedy and light stories.

urban-live-action.title: Urban live-action short drama
urban-live-action.description: Neutral city tones, East Asian actors, lived-in wardrobe; natural light and restrained performance for workplace and romance.

period-live-action.title: Period / historical live action
period-live-action.description: Lock one historical era, then unify hair, costume systems, props, and architecture with low-saturation Eastern color.

suspense-noir.title: Suspense crime night
suspense-noir.description: Blue-black low-key base with sparse danger accents; unified night city materials, practical light, and psychological pressure for clues and twists.

chinese-2d.title: Guoman 2D
chinese-2d.description: Semi-realistic guoman characters, mineral Eastern color, and meticulous scenes; stable line art and silhouettes for cross-episode consistency.

ink-narrative.title: Ink narrative
ink-narrative.description: Xuan-paper negative space with dark/light ink and sparse vermilion; identity via contour and brush—not unreadable ink blobs.

three-d-cartoon.title: 3D cartoon short drama
three-d-cartoon.description: Clear stylized 3D characters, soft materials, bright color; readable expressions and stable assets for comedy, kids, and healing stories.

fantasy-3d.title: Guofeng 3D fantasy
fantasy-3d.description: Semi-realistic Eastern figures, credible Chinese architecture, layered materials; spell colors by faction, VFX only for action and story beats.

future-tech.title: Future tech
future-tech.description: Clean white-gray spaces, precise industrial structure, cool light; tech from function and material—not wall-to-wall neon HUDs.

cyberpunk-neon.title: Cyber neon
cyberpunk-neon.description: Dense Asian night cities, wet aged materials, controlled neon; identity via cybernetics, class costume, and corporate color.

retro-hong-kong.title: Retro Hong Kong
retro-hong-kong.description: 80s–90s Chinese urban film color, dense streets, lived-in clothes; tungsten warmth, teal shadows, and era props.

clay-stop-motion.title: Clay stop-motion
clay-stop-motion.description: Hand-sculpted clay, miniature sets, frame-by-frame motion; unified scale, grain, and light for a warm handmade world.

black-white-noir.title: Black-and-white silent
black-white-noir.description: B&W grayscale, hard light, restrained performance readable without dialogue; period feel from framing and craft—not vintage filters.

space-opera.title: Space opera
space-opera.description: Grand interstellar scale with clear faction costume and credible spacecraft; color and emblems drive politics—not spectacle piles.

comic-pop.title: Comic panels
comic-pop.description: High-contrast blocks, halftone, comic rhythm for action comedy; exaggeration from framing and pose with continuous assets.

storybook-fantasy.title: Storybook fairy tale
storybook-fantasy.description: Paper grain, soft color blocks, hand-drawn edges; clear expressions—avoid reducing storybook feel to soft-focus filters.

surreal-dream.title: Surreal dream
surreal-dream.description: Real materials meet impossible space via mirrors, scale shifts, and mist; every surreal change serves psychology and clues.

nature-healing.title: Nature healing
nature-healing.description: Real daylight, plants, and handmade living; healing via season, sound, and small actions—not ad-style empty landscapes.

real-life-documentary.title: Everyday documentary
real-life-documentary.description: Natural earth tones, ordinary East Asian people, local Chinese spaces; keep environmental traces and observational tone.
